This prevents\ncross-domain session deletion in MCD deployments.</p>\n<dl class=\"field-list simple\">\n<dt class=\"field-odd\">Parameters<span class=\"colon\">:</span></dt>\n<dd class=\"field-odd\"><ul class=\"simple\">\n<li><p><strong>claims</strong> \u2013 <p>Claims from the logout token.
